# Hedgefondförvaltaren positiv: “Någonting håller på att ske”

**Feed**: borslunch  
**Published**: 2026-11-16  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Stefan Roos, an Origo Fonder hedge fund manager, is constructive on equities over 6-12 months. He points to a broadening rotation into value and quality factors, and to Carnegie data showing net upward earnings revisions for Nordic small caps after a three-year consolidation, which he thinks makes small caps attractive. He discusses spin-off theses in SKF and Octave and holdings in Avarda and MTG, while news covered Goldman cutting its Rheinmetall target, gains in healthcare stocks and Telia's AI-infrastructure partnership.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SKF-B — SKF | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Guest bought over the summer; P/E ~10 vs Atlas at 20x; industrial margin 16% expected to rise to 19-20% after the spin-off.

#### Reasoning

Hedge fund manager (guest) holds SKF for the high-margin industrial unit (80-90% of value). Profits have risen while multiples have not. The spin-off speeds up the transformation and factory closures (Mexico saving up to 500m). If the margin reaches 19-20%, SKF matches quality-engineering peers trading at ~20x, which implies a re-rating.

#### Sell Triggers

- if industrial operating margin fails to expand toward 19-20%
- if restructuring/factory closures stall after the split
- if multiple re-rates to peer levels (thesis played out)

> *"Jag tror att vi kommer att se rörelse marginalen på industri upp mot 19–20 %. Då är man ikapp det som vi brukar betrakta som finverkstad."*

---

### 🟡 MTG-B — MTG | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Large fund holding; India IPO cancelled and report sold off, but guest found report OK and says margins are improving.

#### Reasoning

Guest still holds a large position despite two setbacks. MTG is lifting margins through efficiency and game upgrades in a tough market. Uncertainty remains over organic growth in the gaming market and over the timing of the Play Simple IPO, which would release cash for buybacks.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Play Simple IPO is abandoned entirely
- if organic growth in gaming market turns negative
- if margin improvement stalls

> *"Några bolag, bl.a. MTG, har gjort det jättebra i en tuff marknad. Men frågan hänger lite kvar."*

---

### 🟠 SAAB-B — Saab | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Guest questions whether Saab can convert its order book into high margins; historically it has not.

#### Reasoning

Defence sector has been weak this year with profit warnings. Guest is sceptical that order books turn into margins because of long lead times and small production runs, which limit economies of scale.

> *"Det man alltid funderar på, även med Saab är om de kan förvandla orderboken till höga marginaler. Och det kan ju inte Saab, historiskt i alla fall."*

---
